主要内容: On July 14, 2015, Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) and BB&T Capital Markets executed an agreement to repurchase up to 400,000 shares of its common stock, representing approximately 6% of the current shares outstanding. The repurchase plan, approved by the Board of Directors, is expected to be executed over the next 24 to 36 months. The program allows the company to buy shares in open market transactions, with the timing and amount determined by management based on market conditions and capital allocation. Purchases will only occur during periods when management and the Board are not aware of material inside information that could influence a seller’s decision. No shares had been repurchased as of the filing date. As of July 14, 2015, Optical Cable Corporation had approximately 7.1 million common shares outstanding. The company is a leading manufacturer of fiber optic and copper data communication cabling and connectivity solutions primarily for the enterprise market, offering an integrated suite of high quality products that operate as a system solution or seamlessly integrate with other providers’ offerings.
